1.20.1.1.1.0: All textures replaced by a new set by Marioluigi7896 that better matches the vanilla dye pallette
1.20.1.1.2.0: Added 17 types of coloured water: craft with snow block + dye + an empty bucket.
1.20.1.1.2.1: Fix Goats not being able to spawn on coloured grass (by removing 'noOcclusion()' internal setting so that it matches vanilla dirt transparency).  Fix missing 'minecraft:mineable/' tags for harvesting some blocks (Chiseled Stone, Stairs, slabs, path blocks).  Removed error log mentioning 'its not a vanilla 16x dye...'
1.20.1.1.2.2: fix stonecutter stairs regular stone recipe
1.20.1.1.3.0: Fix: sneak-dyeing multiple dyed water blocks now works correctly.  Fix: Dyeing colourful path blocks in world no longer becomes farmland.  Colourful farmland is now hidden from the JEI menu.  New config value in_world_dye.consume, so you can control whether dyeing blocks in world consumes the dye-item you are holding or not.  You can now write on coloured stuff blocks using Chalk (from the chalk mod) without dyeing the block (see new data tag forge:tools/stationery to edit or add tool-dyes).  Add Wooden Buttons, Pressure Plates, Doors, and Boats with textures by MarioLuigi7896
1.20.1.1.3.1: Fix particles of farmland block.  Can dye slabs, stairs, walls, etc, after placing them in the world. Added 2x17 new blocks: all colours of log 'Wood' and 'Stripped Wood'
1.20.1.1.3.2: Fix wooden gates loot tables.  Merge three pull requests from Muddr:   Fixes log_horizontal_light_blue.json to use light blue instead of green.Fixes log_horizontal_light_blue.json to use light blue instead of green. Updates cobblestone_blue.json to use cobblestone instead of stone
1.20.1.1.3.3: Leaves are now non-solid blocks so they do not suffocate players #10.   fix consume config not being applied to some blocks and fluids such as water
